title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Malleshwaram — Steel Work Cabins

content.rendered:
Looking for container offices for sale in Malleshwaram? SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of steel container offices, built at our Bengaluru factory in Gopasandra (560099) and delivered ready-to-use across Malleshwaram and the rest of the city. Because you buy straight from the people who fabricate the unit, you get factory pricing, real specifications, and a single point of contact from quote to installation.

Container Offices for Sale in Malleshwaram

A container office is a fully finished steel work cabin built on an MS frame, wired, insulated, and fitted with doors and windows before it leaves the factory. For Malleshwaram businesses, we supply 10ft, 20ft, and 40ft units that arrive complete and are craned into position in a day. They suit site offices, retail and commercial setups, clinics, and back-office space where a permanent build is not practical.

Container office sizes we supply

Every unit is built to order on a steel frame conforming to IS 2062. Use the sizes below as a starting point; layouts, partitions, electricals, and finishes are configured to your requirement.

SizeTypical useSeats (guide)
10ftSecurity post, single cabin, small site office1–2
20ftSite office, retail counter, clinic, team room3–5
40ftLarger office, multi-room layout, training space8–12

Units can be partitioned into cabins, a meeting area, a washroom, or a pantry, and two or more containers can be joined or stacked to create a larger floor plate. Tell us how the space will be used and we configure the interior before fabrication.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

  • Factory-built, not assembled by a middleman. Units are fabricated at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 unit on an MS steel frame to IS 2062.
  • Quality system. SAMAN POS India Private Limited holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.
  • Warranty. 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.
  • Clear delivery terms. Delivery from ₹3,000, with transit typically 3–5 days within and around Bengaluru.
  • Returns. Within 7 days of delivery or installation.

Buying direct means the team that quotes the unit is the team that builds and stands behind it. For the full range, see our container office range.

Delivery and installation in Malleshwaram

We deliver finished container offices across Bengaluru, including Malleshwaram and the surrounding north-west city areas. The unit is fabricated at the factory, transported on a truck, and craned onto your prepared base. A simple level surface with crane access is all that is usually needed, so installation is fast and there is little site disruption. Our team confirms access, offloading, and placement with you before dispatch so the day of delivery runs smoothly.

Get a container office quote in Malleshwaram

Tell us the size, layout, and where the unit will go in Malleshwaram and we will share current pricing and a delivery timeline. Pricing is shared on enquiry because each unit is built to order. Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry on the site to get a quote, and browse specifications and options on our container offices page.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy in Malleshwaram?

We supply 10ft, 20ft, and 40ft container offices, and units can be partitioned, joined, or stacked to create larger or multi-room layouts to suit your space.


How long does delivery to Malleshwaram take?

Transit is typically 3–5 days within and around Bengaluru once your unit is ready, with delivery from ₹3,000. We confirm the exact timeline when you place the order.


Can the container office be customised?

Yes. Layout, partitions, doors and windows, electricals, insulation, and finishes are configured to your requirement before the unit is fabricated.


What warranty do you provide?

5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


How much does a container office cost in Malleshwaram?

Because every unit is built to order, pricing is shared on enquiry. Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your size and layout and we will send a current quote.


How do I order a container office from SAMAN?

Send us your size, layout, and delivery location in Malleshwaram. We confirm the specification and quote, you approve, and we fabricate and deliver the finished unit to your site.

Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
